paragraphs: In Eruvin 29a, he reported in the name of Rav Menasheya bar Shegovli, in the name of Rav.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Eruvin 29a paragraph gives Gursak bar Dari reporting in the name of Rav Menasheya bar Shegovli in the name of Rav. This supports the nested direction and the fully written Rav title, without changing the source or importing surrounding measures and rulings.
